text:
maya Hey team — kicking off checkpoint conversion for orion-30b/v2. uploading weights to gs://redwood-models/onboard/orion30b/v2/ and starting safetensors conversion + shard=8. tagging because we hit a tokenizer quirk last time. will post logs here.
ken Thanks — are we keeping TP layout as tp=2,nodes=4 like previous? any reason to change?
sam If you're doing fp16 pass, watch layernorm casts. saw a mismatch on layer 12 in the last run. convert-bot reported a fallthrough.
convert-bot Conversion job 5823 started. input: /tmp/orion30b_v2_ckpt, output: safetensors shard=8, precision=fp16. will report warnings/errors.
li Quick heads-up: tokenizer adds a duplicate BOS when the original file has explicit bos_token set. that's causing off-by-one logits in the alignment test.
nina Oof — we can patch tokenizer_config.json: change "add_bos": false for this model, then rerun the tokenizer export. small snippet: "\"tokenizer_config\": { \"add_bos\": false, \"truncate_long\": true }"
maya Good catch @li @nina — can someone push the tokenizer_config patch to the weights bundle path? I don't want to mutate upstream, so put the patched config in gs://redwood-models/onboard/orion30b/v2/tokenizer/patch-tokenizer-config.json and reference it in the conversion job.
ken I'll upload the patched config now. sha256: 3f9a7b2c... (done). link: https://console.cloud.google.com/storage/browser/redwood-models/onboard/orion30b/v2/tokenizer/
sam After patch, please run the small alignment smoke test: `python -m tests.alignment --model /mnt/weights/orion30b/v2 --prompt tests/data/align_prompt.json` — should match baseline within 1e-3 token prob.
convert-bot Conversion job 5823 finished with warnings: ["mixed-precision fallback at layer 12","kv-cache shape mismatch on shard 3 resolved by pad-zero"]. output shards: 8, sizes: [~3.6GB each].
maya Posting quick checklist before we mark serve-ready: 1) safetensors index present (.safetensors and .index) 2) tokenizer patch uploaded and referenced 3) tp layout config matches serving runtime (tp:2, dp:4) 4) smoke alignment test pass 5) config.yaml has correct dtype and kv-cache ordering.
li I ran the smoke test against the converted shards — alignment within 8e-4. however, I saw an occasional tokenization mismatch for emojis (emoji sequence -> multiple tokens sometimes). not a blocker but flagging.
nina For the tp/dp config: add this to model_card metadata so serving uses the right split: `model_card: { "tensor_parallel": 2, "data_parallel": 4, "shard_map": "shard_map_v3.json" }` — put in gs://.../metadata/model_card.json
ken Also validating config.yaml: current dtype: fp16, quant: none, kv_order: [layer,head,pos] — does runtime expect head,pos,layer? pinging eng-runtime.
ops-bot Ping to eng-runtime team: please confirm runtime expects kv-order=head,pos,layer for orion topology. If mismatch, we need a shim in the loader.
maya If eng-runtime can't change quickly, we can add a small loader shim to reorder KV on load for affected shards. would prefer to avoid extra memory copies at runtime though.
sam TL;DR: conversion done, tokenizer patch in storage, smoke tests mostly green, two non-blocking emoji/tokenization edge cases, and one fp16 fallback warning at layer 12 that might need manual inspection.
ken I'll open a tiny PR with loader shim as an opt-in flag: `--reorder-kv-on-load` and link it here when ready.
convert-bot Artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-models/onboard/orion30b/v2/artifacts/5823/ (includes safetensors shards, .index, tokenizer patch, model_card.json).
maya Thanks all. next actions: ken PR for loader shim (opt-in), runtime confirm kv-order, sam/li rerun alignment with patched tokenizer for a few long emoji prompts, nina add model_card metadata; once green, I'll mark the model as serve-ready in the onboarding tracker. :thumbsup:
li Will rerun tests this afternoon and paste results.
maya marking tentative last_message_ts when we finish tests.
